name: hsharp
description: h#: shared semantic core with customizable syntax and C#, Rust, Go, Java, C++, and JavaScript code generation

scripts.check: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js check examples/calculate.hs
scripts.test:property: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js prop --count 10 --seed 1 --max-size 3
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run vscode:typecheck && npm run test:bridge && node dist/cli/index.js test --all-targets
scripts.site:dev: npm run site:data && node site/scripts/prepare-i18n.mjs && npm --prefix site run dev
scripts.site:build: npm run site:data && node site/scripts/prepare-i18n.mjs && npm --prefix site run build && node site/scripts/localize-build.mjs && node site/scripts/generate-seo.mjs
scripts.site:preview: npm run site:build && npm --prefix site run preview
scripts.doctor: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js doctor
scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js demo
